summary: Build the BC.GAME-style casino layout kit for GLOBAL POOL (app shell + lobby content components) in Figma

ledger.status: NOT BUILT: reused existing Nav/Mobile Tab Bar 22:5413

issues: Departure from the assignment, made to follow the updated conventions §4 and the demo-data Game catalogue: the Originals group lists the 5 platform games under their catalogue names (Orbit Rush = Crash, Pool Dice = Dice, Double Side = Coinflip, Pool Roulette = Roulette, Twenty-One = Blackjack). I also added one collapsed 'Casino games' group (Slots, Table games, Live casino, Draws & bingo). The computed task said '5 original games, no third-party slots', but the updated conventions now include GP Studios original slots. The orchestrator should confirm which list wins. Reverting means renaming 5 sub-item labels and deleting one item in 23:5648, 23:6001, 23:6381 and 23:6531.

I did not build a Shell/Mobile Tab Bar because Nav/Mobile Tab Bar (22:5413) already exists and I reused it. Its first tab is labelled 'Home', not 'Lobby'; changing that is up to that component's owner.

Notifications reuse Nav/Notifications Trigger (16:3356), which is itself a Button/Icon plus Badge/Count. The Restricted topbar reuses Nav/Region Banner Desktop (16:3449), whose copy is honest and has no VPN hint. In that state Sign up is Disabled and Sign in stays so existing holders can withdraw.

The Expanded Member sidebar uses 893 of the 897 px nav height at 1024. Any more items will scroll; the 'Nav (scrolls)' frame clips by design. In the mobile drawer the nav list is cut off mid-row on purpose to show it scrolls, with a scroll indicator. A strict 'no clipped text' check may still flag it.
The Collapsed sidebar (72) has no LIVE dot on Global Pool and no licence text. It shows a language icon button, a licence icon button (with tooltip) and the 18+ badge.

In the sidebar and drawer footers, the Notice/Licence Compact instance text is overridden to 'Licence required · Permitted regions only', because the 18+ badge sits beside it. In the 240 sidebar it wraps to 3 lines and its radius is overridden to md.

Swapping an icon on a Shell/Sidebar Item instance drops the colour override. Consumers must re-tint the nested 'Icon' layer and keep it 20x20; this is noted in the component description and the registry.

Tooling: createComponent() sets strokesIncludedInLayout=true by default, which made the topbars 65 px tall. I fixed the topbars to exactly 64 (Restricted is 129). The sidebar's 1px right hairline is still counted inside its 240 width.

Tooling: the inline node.screenshot() rendered icon/default icons black (a render race). get_screenshot rendered them correctly and the variable resolves to light ink/100, so I used get_screenshot for every verification.

The footer community icons (X / Tg / Dc / Yt) are neutral text placeholders because the library has no social icons. The trust strip uses outlined text badges only: no award seals and no third-party logos.
The reference sites' VPN or geo-bypass hints and award seals were deliberately not reproduced. No logos, mascots, photos or copy were taken from them; only layout architecture and density.

issues: Deviation from the brief: Row/Game Carousel holds 6 tiles, not 8. The product has exactly 6 titles (Global Pool plus 5 originals), and padding the row with placeholder or third-party games would break the product facts. The cropped-last-tile pattern is shown in Layout=Overflow (960 wide, Blackjack cropped, scroll indicator). Layout=Fits (1136) shows all 6 tiles with both arrows disabled.

Hover 'lift' cannot be expressed as a translate inside a component. It is shown as a 2px border/brand stroke + Glow/Brand + overlay. translateY(-4px) and 150 ms ease-out are documented in the Tile/Game description for dev.

Variable-bound gradient stops take their alpha from the token. True fade-to-transparent gradients therefore use the existing Gradient/Gold Radial and Hero Radial paint styles, or blurred alpha/* shapes (LAYER_BLUR). No raw hex was used.

Invented values, all marked DEMO: player counts per game (Roulette 1,062, Crash 896, Dice 538, Coinflip 214, Blackjack 347; Global Pool 3,412 = round participants), recent-win and live-bet rows (pool prizes reconcile to round #1,247 at 50/20/10%), and next round #1,249 opening 28 Nov 2026 08:00 UTC (countdown 11:57:50 from settlement at 20:02:10). The Open countdown 03:17:42 to the real 20:00 UTC close comes from demo-data.md.
Contact emails use the reserved placeholder domain globalpool.example with DEMO badges. Replace them once real addresses exist.
Notice/Licence (Inline) does not wrap inside a 360px column, so it sits under the SEO paragraphs in the left column instead of in the contact column.
Two backdrop frames ('Row/Carousel Header — backdrop', 'Banner/Hero Carousel — backdrop') sit behind those two standalone components for documentation contrast only. They are not components.

Reference screenshots were used for layout and density only. No logos, mascots, photos, third-party game art or copy from BC.GAME or HyperLucky were reproduced. VPN hints, bonus pressure and fake urgency were excluded.
